description.value: You've studied the haunting, howling compositions of your ancestors and perhaps developed some of your own. Your resonant voice has the capacity to draw an audience in and make them forget the world around them. You become trained in Performance. If you would automatically become trained in Performance (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the Fascinating Performance skill feat.

publication.title: Starfinder Secrets of the Swarm Adventure Path
